title: Reusable Falcon 9 Launcher from Space-X!
summary: A SpaceX concept animation showing the planned fully reusable Falcon 9, with both first and second stages performing vertical landings.
why: Linked as a historical artifact of SpaceX's early reusability ambitions, including the once-planned reusable second stage.
